text:
maria (Docs): Opening a PR to consolidate rate-limits + quota dashboard docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823

dan (Eng): Nice. Heads up: runtime changed header name to `X-Redwood-Usage` in v2. Need SDK code snippet updated. @maria

maria (Docs): Got it. Current snippet uses `X-Usage` — will swap. Also planning to add a short migration note for Dedicated customers (pinning behavior + rollout guidance).

liam (Analytics): For dashboards: panel `quota_consumption` should be renamed and note that burst credits are now a separate metric. Can you add a sample Grafana query?

maria (Docs): Adding query. Drafted example:
```sql
sum(rate(quota_consumption_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (tier)
```
Want to show burst credits overlay as a second series.

sarah (PM): SG. Also add copy for tier descriptions: Starter / Scale / Enterprise mapping + the threshold numbers and example customer profiles. Keep it short.

dan (Eng): One more: when we mention rate limits, include the new soft-fallback behavior: automatic model downgrade to a cheap-quantized variant (with a note on quality tradeoffs). A single sentence is fine.

docs-bot: Link check: found 1 broken link in PR -> https://old-docs.redwood.ai/ratecap (please fix)

maria (Docs): Thanks bot. Replaced that link and updated README anchors. Also added SDK snippets for curl + Python v2. Examples: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Usage: app=foo" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```
```py
client.generate(..., headers={"X-Redwood-Usage": "app=foo"})
```

dan (Eng): LGTM. Please add a quick note about cost impact: batching + KV caching reduces token unit cost ~35% for chat workloads (cite internal perf benchmark).

maria (Docs): Added a small cost example and linked the internal benchmark doc (internals/perf/kv-batching-2026). Ping @liam for final label check on dashboard panels.

liam (Analytics): Checked labels. Patch looks good. Left one nit: use `rate_limit_policy` tag instead of `policy` to avoid collisions with other dashboards.

maria (Docs): :thumbsup: Will update now. When this merges, can someone trigger the docs deploy? @ops

ops-bot: Docs deploy scheduled. ETA ~10m after merge.
